human.name: human
human.description: Versatile and ambitious, humans are the most adaptable of all races.

elf.name: elf
elf.description: Graceful and long-lived, elves possess keen senses and a deep connection to magic.
traits: Fey Ancestry (advantage vs charm, immune to sleep)
Trance (4 hours of meditation instead of 8 hours sleep)

dwarf.name: dwarf
dwarf.description: Stout and resilient, dwarves are master craftsmen with an affinity for stone and metal.
traits: Dwarven Resilience (advantage vs poison, resistance to poison damage)
Tool Proficiency (smith's, brewer's, or mason's tools)

halfling.name: halfling
halfling.description: Small but nimble, halflings are cheerful folk known for their luck and courage.
traits: Halfling Nimbleness (move through larger creatures' spaces)
